definitions.gloss: to cheer; to root for; to support (a team or person)
definitions.explanation: To encourage and show support for someone, typically at a sporting event or competition, by cheering, clapping, or shouting.

definitions.gloss: to support; to back up; to send reinforcements
definitions.explanation: To provide help or assistance to someone, either through encouragement or by sending additional people or resources.

examples.japanese: チームを{応援|おうえん}する。
{家族|かぞく}みんなで{試合|しあい}を{応援|おうえん}しに{行|い}った。
examples.english: The whole family went to cheer at the game.

examples.japanese: {声|こえ}を{枯|か}らして{選手|せんしゅ}たちを{応援|おうえん}した。
examples.english: I cheered for the athletes until my voice was hoarse.

examples.japanese: いつも{応援|おうえん}しています。
{友人|ゆうじん}の{新|あたら}しい{挑戦|ちょうせん}を{応援|おうえん}する。
examples.english: To support a friend's new challenge.

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しい{店|みせ}に{本社|ほんしゃ}から{応援|おうえん}のスタッフが{来|き}た。
examples.english: Support staff came from headquarters to help out at the busy store.

notes:
One of the most common words for showing support. In everyday conversation, {応援|おうえん}する covers both cheering at events and general emotional support. The phrase いつも{応援|おうえん}しています is a warm, encouraging expression often used on social media or toward public figures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- チームを{応援|おうえん}する: to cheer for a team
- {応援|おうえん}に{駆|か}けつける: to rush to cheer/help
- {応援|おうえん}{団|だん}: cheering squad, pep squad
- {応援|おうえん}{歌|か}: fight song, cheer song
- {応援|おうえん}{演説|えんぜつ}: campaign speech (in support of a candidate)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {支援|しえん}する: to support, assist — more formal; used for aid and institutional support
- {声援|せいえん}を{送|おく}る: to send cheers — specifically vocal encouragement
- {後押|あとお}しする: to back up, give a push — emphasizes practical help
